notes.title: 《Drifting : Weight of Feathers》 Releasing Tomorrow!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405672/68a4aa53ece6e6f1e3c7e6c6e54a6382713bf76f.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 

I am excited (and a little bit nervous) to announce that my game [b]《Drifting : Weight of Feathers》[/b] is going to be released tomorrow (Dec. 15th, 2021 PST)!

Thank you all for following the progress of my game and giving me feedback and bug reports! It's been a long and difficult journey and I'm happy you can stay with me until the release date!


[b]《Drifting : Weight of Feathers》[/b] is a fast-paced, action-oriented game. The moves Faye can do are all designed around the concept of enabling players to engage in combat and puzzle-solving while on walls or in mid-air.

[previewyoutube=9FQSZTHGICA;full][/previewyoutube]

Before diving into the actual gameplay, I would like to kindly ask you to first browse through her move list through [b]menu > options > move list[/b] and make sure you know how to perform all her moves - the difference between knowing only the basics and the full list of her moves has a HUGE impact on how you would approach the game!

[b]《Drifting : Weight of Feathers》[/b] has a steep learning curve, however, the game is by no means difficult in the traditional sense. 

Feel free to join the game's [url=https://discord.gg/22k4b6G9gK][b]Discord[/b][/url] if you would like to share your gameplay footage or ask around for help! 

Have fun exploring the ocean-engulfed planet Bluestar and Merry Christmas! 

Sincerely

Ming Yen Wu - the developer of [b]《Drifting : Weight of Feathers》[/b]

[i]Dec. 14th, 2021 Hsinchu County Taiwan[/i]

notes.title: 《Drifting : Weight of Feathers》 Dev Answers Your Questions!
notes.content:
[h2]Development[/h2]

[b]Q: How long have you been working on 《Drifting : Weight of Feathers》?[/b]
A: The project started in March of 2018 and the demo was released around December of 2020. So about 3 years!

[b]Q: Where did the music for the game come from? [/b]
A: The music for the game are pre-made soundtracks that I purchased from[url=https://audiojungle.net/] Audio Jungle[/url].

[b]Q: Is Linux and/or Mac support planned? [/b]
A: Due to the time constraint of this project, I’m afraid it’s not possible to support other platforms besides Windows. I will say though, that after release, I plan to port the game to Steam Deck should steam approve my application. 

[b]Q: Does the game have RTX built-in? [/b]
A: I’m sorry to say that the game does not have an RTX feature. It doe have dynamic (one-bounce) global illumination through LPV settings. However, the end result couldn’t compare with RTX. 

[b]Q: How much will the game cost at full release? [/b]
A: I don’t have an exact number planned yet, but it will likely cost around $10-$12.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[b]Q: I've watched the gametrailer but it's still hard to understand the game! [/b]
A: The gameplay loop requires players to throw enemies and kill them at the right time and spot. You will need to grab the orb enemy dropped and throw it onto orb holders to unlock passageway to the next level. This seemingly simple loop will gradually becomes harder and harder as you play through the game, challenging your motor skills and understanding of the game's mechanics!

[b]Q: How many levels will be included in the full game? [/b]
A: There will be 6 levels in the game. Each level will take the player around 25-30 minutes to complete. (Although for an inexperienced player it may take them up to double the time). 

[b]Q: How long does it take to beat the current demo as of the 2.9 Update release? [/b]
A: The length of the demo is about 10 minutes but it could be a bit more than that for those learning and getting used to the controls. 

[b]Q: How long does it take to beat the full game? [/b]
A: My average playtime is 20 minutes per level, a full playthrough will take about 2 hours to complete, for newcomers, the average estimated play time might be 2 to 3 times longer (according to past test play sessions). I will report a more accurate total play time estimation before the game's official release on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1378350/discussions/]Steam discussion board[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/zVbc3p3C]Discord server[/url]. 

[b]Q: How many new hair options will be available in the full game for Faye? [/b]
A: There will be a total of 7 hairstyles unlockable in the full game!

[b]Q: What resolution will the game support? [/b]
A: The game only supports 16:9 resolutions ranging from 720p, 1080p to 2k and 4k. Additionally, the game also support 2x sampling with 720p and above (increase texture sharpness under the same resolution)!

[b]Q: Aiming the silver orbs to the orb holders is a bit tricky at times - how does the grappling hook throw works in the game? [/b]
A: Throwing in [b]《Drifting : Weight of Feathers》[/b] has two critical features:

1. Game system will automatically detect the closest throwable object for you. As long as the throwable object is within your viewport, system will indicate the locked on object with white circle around it - the only thing you  need to aim (the camera) at is the target you're about to throw at.

2. Throw forward and throw left / right / back works differently. While throw forward requires you to aim at target; system will automatically select the appropriate target for you when throw left / right / back, if no target is available, the throw trajectory will be determined according to your camera's facing (ex: throw left corresponds to your camera's left vector). 

([i]for a more comprehensive answer to this question, please refer to this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1378350/discussions/0/2958292387844051870/]post[/url][/i])

[b]Q: How does wall-run works in the game? [/b]
A: My goal is to make the wall-run control scheme as close as possible to a regular 2D movement control: press forward while wall-running and Faye will move towards where your camera is pointing at; press left or right while wall-running and she will strafe left or right with respect to your camera's forward facing.

([i]for a more comprehensive answer to this question, please refer to this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1378350/discussions/0/2958292387844051870/]post[/url][/i])

[h2]Future Prospect[/h2]

[b]Q: Are there any DLC or bonus levels planned for after launch? [/b]
A: I definitely have plans for DLC after release. Follow the game on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378350/Drifting__Weight_of_Feathers/]Steam[/url] or join [url=https://discord.gg/zVbc3p3C]Discord server[/url] to receive latest information regarding future content!

[b]Q: Are there any plans to expand on the game’s story? [/b]
A: For most of the game’s development I’ve been focused on the gameplay side of things. In terms of story, I’ve outlined a very simple background and objective for the protagonist. The whole game is about her escaping planet Bluestar - purely gameplay, no dialogue or cinematic cutscenes apart from the introduction. I definitely wish to expand upon her story a bit more after the game’s full release. Perhaps for future DLC!

notes.title: 《Drifting : Weight of Feathers》 Demo2.7 Gamepad Support and Online Leaderboard
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

I'm glad to announce Ver2.7 update is out and available for [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378350 ]download[/url][/b]! 

There are 3 major features in this patch: [b]online leaderboard[/b], [b]XboxOne gamepad support[/b], and [b]wall-run optimization and bug fixing[/b].

[previewyoutube=QHUBJV-QJhY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Online Leaderboard[/h2]

If you've completed the 2nd level and have a score recorded on the off-line ranking board before Ver2.7, [b]you can now upload your score by clicking Main_Menu > Options > Map_Demo_2 > Online_Ranking > Upload_Score[/b], and your Steam account name will appear on the online ranking board!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38405672/65918232abce02a62c34b12d39bc38e6be565a1c.png[/img]

Additionally, [b]your subsequent best scores will automatically[/b] (if an internet connection is available) [b]be uploaded to the online ranking board[/b]; if you do not have an internet connection at the time, don't worry! You can always manually update the record after you gain an internet connection! 

Have fun beating the time challenge and get your name on top 10! :D 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38405672/1940a6985ce125d94f85aa4c1cdaa5f5b1b03a26.jpg[/img]

[h2]XBoxOne Gamepad Support[/h2]

XBoxOne gamepad is now integrated into the game's UI and gameplay controls. Although this feature is still in the alpha phase, players can now complete the entire demo with their preferred controls and key binds - yes that's right, the game also [b]supports gamepad key rebinding![/b] 

[b]Functions that are not supported by gamepad controls are text input, scroll box input, and interacting with the Steam overlay. [/b]

Hopefully, I can revisit these issues and make refinements to them before the final release!


[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38405672/63ef24cd22eac69c3202a6afb6793dbd73220c53.gif[/img]

[h2]Wall-Run Optimization  [/h2]

Wall-run has always been a core feature in [b]《Drifting : Weight of Feathers》[/b], patch Ver2.7 addresses bugs and stability issues that exist in the previous versions. 

Vertical wall-run stuttering is a critical bug that plagues the gameplay for quite a while, in the latest Ver2.7 patch, I streamlined the wall-run algorithm which should [b]eliminate most of the stutterings[/b]. That being said, I'll have to wait and observe if there are any edge cases I haven't noticed.

In addition to streamlining the algorithm, [b]the calculation of wall-run direction has changed from character base to camera base[/b]: the direction when players first enter walls, the moving direction during wall-run, is now determined by camera facing alone. These changes help the controls to be more responsive to players' input during wall-run.


[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

I encourage you to give the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378350 ]demo[/url][/b] another try after downloading the latest Ver2.7 patch and experience (with a gamepad, if you prefer) how the wall-run control has improved from the last update. Meanwhile, don't forget to activate the time challenge, [b]leave your best score on the leaderboard and let other players noticed your amazing performance! :D[/b]

notes.title: 《Drifting : Weight of Feathers》 Demo Ver. 2.1 Major Update!
notes.content:
[h1][b]《Drifting : Weight of Feathers》[/b] Demo Ver. 2.1 Major Update![/h1]

Hello everyone!

[b]《Drifting : Weight of Feathers》[/b] is a third-person / action / shooter / parkour game expected to be released in this (2021) year! As the full game is being developed and refined continuously before the final release date, [b]new features and adjustments will also be made available in the latest demo build![/b] In this article, I would like to address two of the major features included in this update: charged bullet time and heat sink system.

[h3]Charged Bullet Time[/h3]

[previewyoutube=WSoBtMhe2_Y;full][/previewyoutube]

This is probably the most impactful change in the update history so far. Wall dash and ground dash now cannot trigger bullet time, instead, bullet time is triggered whenever players hold down shoot / charge button. [b]The idea is to let players decide when to slow down time instead of forcing them into bullet time whenever they perform a dash.[/b] 

The impact of decoupling bullet time and dash made it possible for players to aim while traveling at high speed; hook and grab were made unaffected by time dilation, so players actually gain an advantage to get to "move first" during bullet time, which enables them to grab or hook while everything is slowing down! 

[h3]Heat Sink System[/h3]

[previewyoutube=Xg-roHAQkck;full][/previewyoutube]

To prevent players from spamming bullet time, the game introduced a heat sink system: each fired shot will increase the heat level of the protagonist's mechanical arm; the heat will evaporate over time, however, rapid consecutive shots will result in overheating her mechanical arm and made her unable to shoot until the heat is completely vented out. 

[b]The heat sink system encourages players to think strategically while leveraging their resources (heat level) and play style.[/b] With a little bit of practice, players should be able to complete the entire game without incurring overheating even once!

[h3]Download The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378350]Demo[/url] And Try It Out Yourself![/h3]

As the developer of the game, I encourage you to download the demo and experience the gameplay yourself! If you've already downloaded the demo prior to this (Ver 2.1) build, I encourage you to download the latest build and play through the demo again and [b]explore what kind of tricks you could do with the newly added features![/b]

Don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378350]wishlist 《Drifting : Weight of Feathers》 on Steam[/url] if you like the gameplay!!

I wish you a great weekend and have fun playing the demo! =)
